Gaps in the numbering (e.g. no 115, 117, 121, 123, 130, 135-149, 308, 312, 326, 335, 412, 426, 435) are as published; several of those numbers are consumed by Diamond Club / suite / club inventory rather than public seating bowls.
discovery.concert_only_note: CONFIRMED - RateYourSeats lists these lettered 'Field' sections under a separate Field Seating (Concert) grouping; they exist only for concert floor configurations and are not baseball seating. Letter I and O are skipped.
discovery.capacity: 40,963 (official Astros figure). Wikipedia lists 41,168 including 5,197 club seats and 63 luxury suites; ballparksofbaseball.com also lists 40,963. Wikipedia level breakdown: 19,201 lower level, 7,132 second level, 880 suite level, 13,750 upper level.

orientation.batter_faces: East-northeast (ENE). A batter standing at home plate looking toward the pitcher and center field faces ENE; home plate sits at the southwest corner of the block and the outfield extends toward the east-northeast. The left-field wall and train track run along the west/north side of the park (the train travels 'along the low roof track on the west side').
orientation.confidence: CONFIRMED (single authoritative source, corroborated by the MLB facts-and-figures description of the train running on the west side above left field)

numbering_direction.summary: Section numbers INCREASE from left field, around through home plate, and on toward right field. Low numbers are in LEFT FIELD / THIRD BASE side; high numbers are on the FIRST BASE side / RIGHT FIELD. Section 100 starts at the left-field foul pole (Crawford Boxes 100-104), numbers climb up the third-base line (105-116), pass directly behind home plate (118-120), continue down the first-base line (122-134), and the 150s wrap around under the scoreboard in right field. The same low-to-high left-field-to-right-field pattern repeats on the 200, 300 and 400 levels.

discovery.bullpens: Astros (home) bullpen is in RIGHT FIELD, immediately adjacent to the Bullpen Boxes: RateYourSeats notes seats 'Near the Astros bullpen (Sections 155-156)' with 'Direct visibility into bullpen activity'. The VISITING bullpen is in LEFT FIELD, described by Clem's Baseball as a covered structure 'below that arched wall' (the arcade beneath/beyond the Crawford Boxes area). CONFIRMED for the Astros bullpen (right field, RateYourSeats bullpen-boxes page); MODERATE confidence for the visiting bullpen in left field (single source, andrewclem.com). The bullpens are on opposite sides beyond the outfield fences, not in foul territory.

accessibility.summary: Wheelchair and companion seating is distributed on every level. Official Astros disability access guide lists accessible seating in Lower Level sections 100, 106, 134, 151, 153, 154, 156; Club Level sections 208, 211, 212, 213, 225, 227, 234; and Terrace Deck sections 305, 307, 309, 311, 314, 316, 318, 320, 322, 324, 327, 329, 331, 333. Companion seats are located adjacent to accessible seats in those same sections. Complimentary courtesy wheelchair service is available at all home games, with staff escorting guests to their seats.

discovery.row_seat_conventions: ROWS ARE NUMBERS, not letters, in the general seating bowl at Daikin Park. CONFIRMED across multiple RateYourSeats section pages: Section 102 (Crawford Boxes) 'Rows in Section 102 are labeled 1-10'; Section 112 'Rows in Section 112 are labeled 5-40'; Section 126 'Rows in Section 126 are labeled 5-40'; Section 152 rows numbered 1-25. Infield/Dugout Box sections behind the plate and the dugouts (roughly 112-126) begin at Row 5 rather than Row 1, while outfield sections start at Row 1. Exception: the premium Phillips 66 Diamond Club uses LETTERED sections (AA, BB, CC, A-F) - those are section labels, not rows. Seat counts per row vary: Dugout Box sections typically have 16 seats labeled 1-16; Bullpen Box section 152 ranges from 13 seats in Row 1 to 24 seats in Rows 12-23.
discovery.seat1_side_verbatim: "When looking towards the field/stage, lower number seats are on the left" - stated verbatim and identically on the RateYourSeats section pages for 102, 112, 126 and 152, i.e. facing the field, seat 1 is on your LEFT and seat numbers increase to the right. Source: https://www.rateyourseats.com/daikin-park/seating/sections/126
discovery.known_obstructions: 1) Bullpen Boxes (sections 150-156) sit under the 200-level overhang in right field beneath the scoreboard - low ceiling, dark viewing conditions, and poor sightlines into parts of the field; the scoreboard directly overhead is not visible from these seats. 2) Chevy Mezzanine sections 250-255 have no armrests between seats. 3) Crawford Boxes (100-104) are high above a 21-25 ft left-field wall and very close to the plate (315 ft), so the left-field corner and the area directly below the wall can be hard to see. 4) For CONCERTS, section 152 (and other right-field/rear sections) is 'behind the stage or to the side of the stage for most concerts. This may restrict or limit your view of the performance.' 5) Roof support columns and the retractable-roof structure can affect some upper-level sightlines - UNCERTAIN, not confirmed on a source page. 6) Rear rows of the 100 level under the 200-level overhang lose sight of high fly balls - typical of the park's deck design, UNCERTAIN as to exact sections.
uncertain: Exact home-plate section numbers on the 200/300/400 levels (219-221, 319-321, 419-421) are inferred from bowl alignment, not confirmed on a source page.
Visiting bullpen location in left field rests on a single source (andrewclem.com, 'below that arched wall'); the Astros bullpen in right field near sections 155-156 is well confirmed.
Capacity is reported as both 40,963 (official Astros / ballparksofbaseball) and 41,168 (Wikipedia). Official figure used.
Suite count reported as both 63 (MLB facts-and-figures, Wikipedia) and 55 (MLB information guide, likely post-renovation).
